title: Demo env hardening
description: Add PM_TOKEN_TTL_HOURS to Settings and use it in auth.synthetic_token (demo value 48). Set PM_RATE_LIMIT=600 in the demo env. Add Gemini env vars (PM_PROVIDER=compatible, PM_PROVIDER_URL=https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai, PM_PROVIDER_MODEL, PM_PROVIDER_KEY). Add scripts/gemini_smoke.py that calls Gemini with a JSON schema.
done_when: Token valid 48 h; smoke test returns schema-valid JSON. If the OpenAI-compatible endpoint rejects response_format json_schema, note it and plan a native call in llm.py.

title: Docs and decision records
description: Commit the technical spec as docs/06-baseline.md. Write docs/decisions/003-change-notifications.md (MVP banned care-driving alerts; Baseline adds decision-support notifications with a budget; diagnosis/treatment/autonomous action stay banned) and docs/decisions/004-timescale.md. Link 06 from AGENTS.md.
done_when: Files merged; AGENTS.md links to 06.

title: Migration 003 and Timescale image
description: Switch the db image to timescale/timescaledb-ha:pg17 (confirm pgvector is present, else install). Add migration pair 003_baseline.py/.sql: voice_checks hypertable, context_tags, assessments, RLS enabled+forced, policies using pm_care(), grants to pm_runtime.
done_when: Migration runs from an empty DB; RLS test as pm_runtime passes on all 3 tables; all existing tests still pass. If RLS doesn't apply to hypertable chunks, fall back to a plain table and record it.

title: Audio normalize, VAD, ASR, timing features
description: speech/audio.py (ffmpeg to 16 kHz mono wav, highpass 80 Hz), speech/vad.py (webrtcvad-wheels, aggressiveness 2, 30 ms frames, pauses >= 250 ms inside speech span), speech/asr.py (faster-whisper base int8 singleton, word_timestamps), speech/features.py (speech_rate_wpm, pause_ratio, mean_pause_s). Pure functions.
done_when: Unit test on synthetic audio with known silences: pause count and pause ratio within 5% of constructed values.

title: Prosody and quality gate
description: speech/prosody.py (parselmouth to_pitch_ac 75-500 Hz, median voiced F0). speech/quality.py with reason codes too_short, too_little_speech, too_few_words, too_noisy, clipped, off_script.
done_when: Short, noisy, clipped and off-script fixtures each return the right reason code.

title: Golden clips
description: Record 4 clips with the fixed prompt: normal, deliberately slow, deliberately pausey, right after climbing stairs. Keep audio out of Git. Add tests marked slow.
done_when: All four clips are usable; slow lowers speech rate; pausey raises pause ratio/count. Stairs features are reported as exploratory without a required direction (approved decision 027; original pitch failure retained).

title: POST /v1/patients/{id}/checks
description: Synchronous multipart upload (audio, mode, device_id, device_ts, is_baseline). Run the pipeline, insert into voice_checks, return features/words/pauses/change/assessment/timings_ms per the contract. Delete temp audio unless PM_KEEP_AUDIO=true. NOTE: the PayloadLimit middleware in src/patient_memory/api.py returns 415 for any body that is not application/json and 413 above max_payload_bytes (2 MB). Allow multipart/form-data for this route before anything else works. A 15 s 44.1 kHz stereo WAV is ~2.6 MB, so only webm/mp4 from MediaRecorder fit under the limit.
done_when: Contract tests: webm, mp4, wav -> 200 with features; short clip -> usable:false; other patient -> 404; >2 MB -> 413 (middleware). p95 under 5 s on the demo host.

title: Change engine
description: baseline/engine.py: stateless; rolling and enrolled baseline modes; same device_id preferred; robust z with MAD floor and abs floors; direction-aware dz; fused score; EWMA (0.3) and CUSUM (k 0.5, h 4); statuses enrolling/none/provisional/change; params echoed. Baselines only use checks with the same prompt_version.
done_when: Unit tests: stable -> none; drift -> change on 2nd check; 3 fresh baseline clips work in enrolled mode; 1 strong clip -> provisional.

title: Structured context and POST /context
description: baseline/context.py rules: high-risk medication lookup -> high_risk_med_new; temperature_c >= 37.8 -> fever_documented; context.* observations -> matching tag. POST /v1/patients/{id}/context creates an observation source via existing ingestion plus a context_tags row.
done_when: An oxybutynin order creates a high_risk_med_new tag with a valid quote span.

title: Gemini context extraction from notes
description: baseline/llm.py client reusing provider settings. Extract explainer/amplifier tags from nursing notes with the spec's system prompt and strict schema; validate each quote as an exact substring and compute offsets; drop misses. Offline keyword fallback when provider is stub or errors. Hook after the worker publishes a note; POST /notes/extract on demand.
done_when: 'Not her usual chatty self' is tagged with valid offsets; a fabricated quote is dropped; offline mode produces the same tags.

title: Verdict table and assessments
description: baseline/verdict.py lookup table per spec; write assessments rows; shift escalation budget (PM_ESCALATION_BUDGET=3, shifts at 07/15/23 local, over_budget flag); PM_NO_ESCALATE_PATIENTS for the runner.
done_when: Every status x context combination maps to exactly one verdict in tests; amplifier wins over explainer; runner never escalates.

title: SBAR draft with validator
description: baseline/sbar.py: Gemini draft for escalate/watch with the 5-rule validator (sections present, IDs allowed, numbers match, banned phrases, R names the action); template fallback; store source gemini|template.
done_when: Wrong number or unknown ID falls back to the template; a valid draft is stored with source gemini.

title: Watch list and overview endpoints
description: GET /v1/watchlist (sorted, escalation counter, watch window, sparkline) and GET /v1/patients/{id}/overview (time_bucket series, baseline band, latest assessment with SBAR, context tags, watch window). Regenerate docs/openapi.json.
done_when: Each page's data in one call; OpenAPI updated.

title: Synthetic cohort loader
description: scripts/load_baseline_demo.py + fixtures/synthetic/baseline_storylines.json: 12 residents x 30 days, fixed seed; Mrs. K, Mr. T, Mrs. L storylines; notes/meds/vitals via existing ingestion; --offline flag.
done_when: One command loads the unit; Mrs. K escalate, Mr. T explained, Mrs. L watch, others within normal.

title: Runner baseline and context
description: Dee replaces the remote runner caller. Enroll five distinct rested recordings through the checks API with mode=runner and is_baseline=true, then use mode=live on the same capture patient/device. Keep the no-escalate profile. No invented marathon context; stairs exploratory (decision 027).
done_when: Five distinct usable baseline checks stored through the API; one usable live check shows the same person's baseline comparison and authorized readback. Stairs has no required direction (decision 027).

title: Frontend scaffold
description: web/ Next.js App Router + TypeScript + Tailwind + Recharts. /api/pm/[...path] proxy route adding the demo token server-side. Types via openapi-typescript from docs/openapi.json. Layout and verdict colour tokens.
done_when: Proxy reaches the API health endpoint with the demo token.

title: /check page
description: Prompt card, record button with 30 s auto-stop and manual Stop (decision 027), MediaRecorder (webm or mp4 on iOS), upload with retries, speech decomposition result view (waveform, word timeline, shaded pauses, 4 numbers vs baseline, verdict), modes resident/runner/live.
done_when: Works on an iPhone and an Android phone over HTTPS on LTE.

title: /unit page
description: Watch list table with verdict chips, watch-window chip, fused z, sparkline, escalation counter; 10 s polling only while visible.
done_when: Sorted list matches the API; polling stops when the tab is hidden.

title: /resident/[id] page
description: Verdict card, 4 small-multiple charts with baseline band and change marker, evidence chain with click-through to /evidence/{id}, SBAR panel with source badge, 'how this was decided' table.
done_when: Every evidence chip opens its source quote; band and markers render for Mrs. K.

title: Compose and HTTPS host
description: compose: db (timescaledb-ha), object-store, api (with ffmpeg), worker (tenant 0 loop), web. Host on a Vultr VM with Caddy + GoDaddy domain, or a laptop + Cloudflare tunnel. Decide by 16:00.
done_when: Public HTTPS URL; a phone on LTE can record and get a result.

title: Demo reset script
description: scripts/demo_reset.py: reload synthetic patients only (never the runner's real clips), mint 48 h tokens, write web/.env.local, print demo URLs.
done_when: One command restores state in under a minute.

title: Repo public and initial Devpost entry
description: Before 21:00 Saturday: scan history for secrets, make the repo public, create the Devpost entry with team members, prize categories (PointClickCare, KAZE, Healthcare, AI for Social Impact, Gemini, Tiger Data, Vultr/GoDaddy if used) and AI tools used (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini).
done_when: Submitted before 21:00 Saturday.

title: Backup video, write-up, README
description: Record the full demo video by 17:00 Saturday; Devpost write-up (why, stack, what it does); README run steps from a clean clone.
done_when: Video saved in two places; README reproduces the demo.

title: Rehearsal and checklist dry run
description: Two full solo run-throughs by the Sunday presenters before 18:00 Saturday; run the demo-day checklist once.
done_when: Both runs under 4 minutes with no manual fixes.

title: KAZE: safety session model and endpoints
description: Migration 004: safety_sessions, escalation_events, session_id + lat/lon/accuracy on voice_checks; arm/status/end endpoints; 24 h deletion job; separate kaze-demo tenant.
done_when: Arming with 3 baseline clips moves the session to active; RLS test passes.

title: KAZE: scheduler and triggers
description: baseline/safety.py in the worker loop every 15 s: missed-check detection, speech-change trigger, ladder levels 0-4.
done_when: Unit tests: on-time check resets; 5 min overdue reaches level 2; ack stops the ladder.

title: KAZE: SMS and acknowledgement
description: Twilio sender (PM_TWILIO_*) with a log fallback; neutral fixed message wording; public GET /ack/{token}.
done_when: A verified phone receives the text; tapping the link marks the session acknowledged.

title: KAZE: /out and session pages
description: Arm flow (contacts, end time, interval, context, 3 baseline clips), countdown + check-in button, judge-facing session timeline.
done_when: Full arm -> miss -> text -> ack loop works on two phones.

title: KAZE: demo and Devpost section
description: Demo script with interval_min = 1; Devpost section mapping to safety, dignity, privacy, autonomy; tick the KAZE prize.
done_when: Rehearsed twice; KAZE selected on Devpost.

title: Signal-adapter registry
description: FeatureSpec registry in baseline/engine.py; per-modality status; corroborated flag on assessments; corroborated provisional treated as change.
done_when: Existing engine tests pass unchanged; a two-modality test sets corroborated.
